item.text:
Implemented `StoreGraph.quoteShipping.execute(orderID:) async -> ShopResult<ShippingQuote>`.

Design note: follows the existing use-case/repository pattern. Blank IDs fail before API access; nonblank IDs pass unchanged to `ShopAPI.shippingQuote`. Reuses `ShippingQuote` validation and transport mapping, preserving cents and currency exactly.

Validation: `swift test` passed all 5 tests, including existing-feature regressions. `git diff --check` passed.
